Downloaded by: research task (owner request: free packs for music/SFX for M5)
Original zip: 15_melodic_rpg_chiptunes_ogg.zip from

Original zip sha256: 85ac8a965d19e8db93f09e57e490080ae4550f3fcdda13de2db61a449b94f094
Format: 15 .ogg tracks (full loop-length compositions, not one-shot stingers).
Covers: rpgchip01_title_screen.ogg (title screen loop candidate),
  rpgchip03_town.ogg (a calm walkable-overworld loop, candidate for the outdoor
  campus bed), rpgchip02_bittersweet_story.ogg (slower/sentimental, candidate
  for the birthday-card ending), plus 12 more (dungeon, battle, airship,
  game-over, etc.) not obviously needed by this game's story but included
  since they were one zip.
Does not cover: short UI/SFX stingers (see the three kenney-* audio folders).
Note: this is the only music (as opposed to sound-effect) pack downloaded --
  M5 (per CONTEXT.md/GAME_PLAN.md) still needs someone to actually pick and
  wire in 2-3 of these 15 tracks; not done here, this is research only.
